policy: Repository tiers represent maintainer priority, not externally certified agent improvement.

entries.name: app-to-scoop
entries.rationale: Scoop packaging has version, hash, asset-selection, and manifest rules that need dependable tools.

entries.name: internal-project-doc-standardizer
entries.rationale: Custom documentation schemas and project status conventions are reusable, but the fixed file set needs flexibility.

entries.name: project-prompt-polisher
entries.rationale: Frequent rough-requirement-to-agent handoff work with an identifiable non-regression contract.

entries.name: visual-story-image-director
entries.rationale: Distinct source-scene preservation rules and editorial storytelling criteria.

entries.name: wechat-article-image-planner
entries.rationale: Article-specific image selection and placement guidance with end-to-end deliverables.

entries.name: ai-coding-discipline
entries.rationale: Most rules are generic coding practices better scoped in project AGENTS.md.

entries.name: ai-coding-paradigm
entries.rationale: Engineering maturity analysis might add depth but needs no-skill comparisons.

entries.name: client-technical-reporting
entries.rationale: Fixed client-report structure can become an opt-in template instead of an always-on skill.

entries.name: market-commercialization-strategist
entries.rationale: Useful evidence discipline, yet scope is wide and independent uplift untested.

entries.name: project-structure-review
entries.rationale: Overlaps architecture and delivery review; maintain compatible invocation during transition.

entries.name: ai-image-quality-reviewer
entries.rationale: Visual QA dimensions fit as a reusable reference in an existing visual workflow.

entries.name: ai-poster-art-director
entries.rationale: Poster hierarchy may justify a specialty after portfolio and task evaluation.

entries.name: brand-visual-system-designer
entries.rationale: System-wide brand consistency differs from one-off image prompting, but the current sketch is thin.

entries.name: consistent-character-designer
entries.rationale: Character identity across scenes is specialized; needs reliable repeatable test assets.

entries.name: creative-reference-analyzer
entries.rationale: A reference analysis step already occurs in the visual-story workflow.

entries.name: image-prompt-engineer
entries.rationale: Mostly generic prompt structuring with no demonstrated independent value.

entries.name: product-visual-designer
entries.rationale: Product evidence and visual conversion merit specialized user-task tests.

entries.name: image-generation-collection
entries.rationale: A curated external repository index, not a runnable skill.
